response.overview: Watch Tammy Pescatelli deliver her hilarious stand-up comedy special, Mrs. Saturday Night, filmed live at the Triad Theater. 😂  Tammy takes the stage in New York City to share her brutally honest take on everyday life. Known for her fearless storytelling and sharp observational comedy, she turns relatable situations into a non-stop series of laughs.  This full comedy special captures Tammy Pescatelli at her best, with an energetic delivery that keeps the audience engaged from start to finish. If you enjoy bold, unfiltered humor from one of the sharpest voices in the industry, this set is for you. 🎤
response.title: Tammy Pescatelli: Mrs. Saturday Night
